Inspected assigned verify.py regenerates the 13 GF(3) projective points, 234 facets and arcs, a unimodular 66-column integral section, mod-2 rank168, mod-3 rank165, a specified exact maximal minor -27 and a full Smith-form check. HOWEVER its RESULT.md additionally states these 234 are "exactly the support-minimal nonzero integral 2-cycles". In the standard inclusion-minimal support meaning this is FALSE. Choose three collinear points A,B,C in PG(2,3), and two off-line points U,V: the six independent triangles UAB,UBC,UCA,VAB,VBC,VCA admit an oriented suspension cycle (the difference of the two cones over boundary ABC). Every one of its six triangles is essential by edge-cancellation propagation, so its 6-triangle support is inclusion-minimal; it spans FIVE vertices and is not a quadrangle tetrahedral boundary. The submitted proof establishes only shortest/minimum-cardinality support (four vertices), not all inclusion-minimal supports. Finite verification of the 234 quadrangles cannot eliminate larger support-minimal cycles. Thus the final claim as worded fails C even though its central lattice invariant is correct.
